say:1:1536143001:1.text: One, if we're lucky. Maybe none.
say:1:1536143001:1.source_cn: 最多一个，要么就是没有。
say:1:1536143001:1.male: One, if we're lucky. Maybe none.
say:1:1536143001:1.female: One, if we're lucky. Maybe none.

say:2:1536143002:1.text: It's a savage ritual. If even one survives, that's a miracle!
say:2:1536143002:1.source_cn: 猎血节这么残酷的节日，能有一个胜者就不错了！
say:2:1536143002:1.male: It's a savage ritual. If even one survives, that's a miracle!
say:2:1536143002:1.female: It's a savage ritual. If even one survives, that's a miracle!

say:3:1536143003:1.text: Most years, not a single warrior makes it back. Dozens go in. None return.
say:3:1536143003:1.source_cn: 更多的时候，几十位战士里都不会产生一位胜者。
say:3:1536143003:1.male: Most years, not a single warrior makes it back. Dozens go in. None return.
say:3:1536143003:1.female: Most years, not a single warrior makes it back. Dozens go in. None return.

say:4:1536143004:1.text: Don't you think that's too cruel? Some of our finest warriors—gone, just like that...
say:4:1536143004:1.source_cn: 你说这样是不是太残酷了？那些可都是最优秀的战士，就这么...
say:4:1536143004:1.male: Don't you think that's too cruel? Some of our finest warriors—gone, just like that...
say:4:1536143004:1.female: Don't you think that's too cruel? Some of our finest warriors—gone, just like that...
